title: taskchat
description: Records stored at (holonId, 'taskchat', <id>). One message of a task's chat, kept in the task's home holon and projected as a NIP-29 kind-9 in the task's group.

task.description: Key of the task (quests lens, same holon) the message belongs to.

author.description: Writer's hex pubkey as stated by the sender; readers prefer the envelope's signer.
